snippet.description:
“YUMBA” explores the uncertainty, frustration and emotional conflict that arise when love is affected 
by changing feelings, mixed signals and broken trust. The song tells the story of two people who still 
care for each other but struggle with disappointment, disrespect and unresolved conflict.
The song’s central chameleon imagery represents unpredictable and constantly changing emotions, 
capturing the experience of questioning where one stands in a relationship. It also reflects the desire to 
preserve love and a shared life despite hurt and emotional inconsistency.

snippet.description:
“Wendo wa Giko” is a Kikuyu vernacular phrase that translates to “dirty love.” The song tells the story of a woman who is unfaithful to her partner, cheating, going out with other men and drinking heavily. After being involved with other men, she eventually wants to return to her husband and the relationship she once had.

However, her actions have changed everything. The husband is deeply hurt and can no longer feel the same love or attraction toward her. “Wendo wa Giko” explores betrayal, regret, lost trust, and the consequences of being unfaithful in a relationship.
